title: sieve-native/evaluator: sieve_glob_to_regex allocates per char via escape()
description: crates/sieve-native/src/evaluator.rs sieve_glob_to_regex() — fancy_regex::escape() is called with a freshly-allocated String per non-wildcard character (other.to_string()). For a pattern like 'user@example.com' this produces 16+ single-char String allocations plus 16+ intermediate escape-result Strings. An accumulator over char slices that only calls escape for regex-special chars would reduce allocation to O(1) per pattern.
